newsitem.title: IRAQ: Saddam adviser dies in "regrettable incident".
newsitem.headline: Saddam adviser dies in "regrettable incident".

text.p: An adviser to Iraqi President Saddam Hussein has died in a "regrettable incident", Baghdad radio said on Sunday without giving further details.

"The Presidential Office regretfully announces the death of the late Abdullah Fadhil al-Samaraa', the adviser at the Presidential Office, who died in a regrettable incident on Saturday night," the radio said quoting a statement from the Presidential Office.
Al-Samaraa' held a number of posts in the ruling Baath party and the Iraqi government.

Before being appointed an adviser, he was the minister for endowment and religious affairs. He was also a senior member of the all-powerful Revolutionary Command Council, the highest authority in Iraq chaired by Saddam.
